description: Omnissiah's Victory, Ark Mechanicus — Adeptus Mechanicus base configuration.

source.note: Source hull profile with Mechanicus fleet costs and mandatory equipment applied. Gifts and purchased refits are resolved separately.

specialRules.name: Mechanicus crew
specialRules.description: Generate Leadership from D6: 1 gives 7, 2–3 gives 8, and 4–6 gives 9. Enemy boarding and hit-and-run attackers may re-roll, accepting the second result. No Space Marine crew bonuses.

specialRules.name: Repair expertise
specialRules.description: Add one repair die when resolving critical damage repairs.

specialRules.name: Quest for Knowledge
specialRules.description: Roll the fleet subplot before battle; use the linked faction tables and record the outcome in notes.

specialRules.name: Heavy manoeuvring
specialRules.description: Cannot use Come to New Heading.

specialRules.name: Unique flagship
specialRules.description: One Ark maximum, in a primarily Mechanicus fleet of at least 1,000 points. Embark an Archmagos Veneratus here.

specialRules.name: Repulsor Shields
specialRules.description: Contact with blast markers or gas clouds does not penalize Leadership, movement or repairs until Shields Collapsed is suffered.

specialRules.name: Augmented Weapon Relays
specialRules.description: Apply a left column shift to batteries before other modifiers; lance rolls of 6 score two hits.

specialRules.name: Fixed equipment
specialRules.description: The listed turret strength and Gifts are already included. Only the launch-bay exchange is available as a purchased refit outside campaigns.
